set -euo pipefail
BASE=0d955ad7802e9bc452ad07bebe475f41d5046529
git fetch origin work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = "$BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
old='        <MapProjectionTracker onProjectorChange={handleProjectorChange} />'
new='        {showPinnedMedia && cards.length > 0 ? <MapProjectionTracker onProjectorChange={handleProjectorChange} /> : null}'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('MapProjectionTracker anchor missing')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-projection-e2e-XXXXXX)
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map.spec.ts e2e/smoke/public-map.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only)" = 'frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx'
git commit -m 'Skip idle pinned media projection tracking'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-straighten-20260912
printf 'published_sha=' && git rev-parse HEAD
